critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, the screen has a cohesive high-polish visual system: strong oversized headline hierarchy, restrained cyan/coral/yellow semantic color, consistent mono micro-labels, subtle grid texture, crisp borders, and a clearly emphasized ROI artifact. The desktop split ledger/result composition reflows cleanly into a stacked card on tablet and mobile. It is demo-ready, though mobile table density is near the limit: the two currency values in “Cost per successful fraud” sit very close together, row labels wrap unevenly, and the oversized four-line title delays the primary data.
critique.fix: Give the mobile ledger more numeric-column separation—slightly reduce value size, widen the card, or stack before/after values within the tightest row. Tighten the mobile hero scale/spacing and normalize wrapped row-label widths to improve rhythm without weakening the hierarchy.
